independently_recomputed_metrics.metric_definition: For each measured invocation and stage, take the median of its three raw elapsed_ns samples. Each of the 48 stage-specific paired deltas is candidate median minus baseline median; paired ratio is candidate median divided by baseline median. AB/BA summaries include 24 pairs each. All raw attempts, samples, paired values, and outlier-sized deltas are retained without filtering.

interpretation: The 48-pair local run_stream microbenchmark shows faster candidate medians in 38/48, 40/48, and 37/48 pairs for 1, 4, and 8 stages respectively. These are narrow fixed-workload results, not a whole-application or general performance claim; every slower pair and all raw samples are retained.

host_stable_identity.host_snapshot_scope: run_started only; the journal run_finished event has no host snapshot

scope: source/build/evidence-only; no Cargo, Rust test, benchmark binary, or product process was invoked by this auditor
